Vulcan's EBITDA reconciliation = net earnings + provision for income taxes (continuing ops) + interest expense, net + (earnings) loss on discontinued operations net of tax (extra field ebitda_bridge_disc_ops, signed as added) + DDA&A (EBITDA excludes discontinued operations).
